event_reward_policies_dates_check.name: event_reward_policies_dates_check
event_reward_policies_dates_check.value: "event_reward_policies"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "event_reward_policies"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "event_reward_policies"."valid_until" >= "event_reward_policies"."valid_from"

feed_posts_cover_storage_check.name: feed_posts_cover_storage_check
feed_posts_cover_storage_check.value:
(
        "feed_posts"."cover_bucket" IS NULL
        AND "feed_posts"."cover_object_key" IS NULL
        AND "feed_posts"."cover_content_type" IS NULL
        AND "feed_posts"."cover_size_bytes" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "feed_posts"."cover_url" IS NULL
        AND "feed_posts"."cover_bucket" IS NOT NULL
        AND "feed_posts"."cover_object_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND "feed_posts"."cover_content_type" IS NOT NULL
        AND "feed_posts"."cover_size_bytes" > 0
      )

point_seasons_dates_check.name: point_seasons_dates_check
point_seasons_dates_check.value: "point_seasons"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "point_seasons"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "point_seasons"."ends_at" >= "point_seasons"."starts_at"

store_product_media_storage_check.name: store_product_media_storage_check
store_product_media_storage_check.value:
(
        "store_product_media"."upload_status" = 'pending'
        AND "store_product_media"."url" IS NULL
        AND "store_product_media"."bucket" IS NOT NULL
        AND "store_product_media"."object_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND "store_product_media"."content_type" IS NOT NULL
        AND "store_product_media"."size_bytes" > 0
        AND "store_product_media"."upload_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "store_product_media"."upload_status" = 'ready'
        AND (
          "store_product_media"."url" IS NOT NULL
          OR (
            "store_product_media"."bucket" IS NOT NULL
            AND "store_product_media"."object_key" IS NOT NULL
            AND "store_product_media"."content_type" IS NOT NULL
            AND "store_product_media"."size_bytes" > 0
          )
        )
      )

store_products_dates_check.name: store_products_dates_check
store_products_dates_check.value: "store_products"."available_until" IS NULL OR "store_products"."available_from" IS NULL OR "store_products"."available_until" >= "store_products"."available_from"

submission_field_values_value_check.name: submission_field_values_value_check
submission_field_values_value_check.value: "submission_field_values"."text_value" IS NOT NULL OR "submission_field_values"."json_value" IS NOT NULL

wallet_accounts_owner_check.name: wallet_accounts_owner_check
wallet_accounts_owner_check.value:
(
        "wallet_accounts"."owner_kind" = 'user'
        AND "wallet_accounts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "wallet_accounts"."system_key" IS NULL
        AND "wallet_accounts"."event_id" IS NULL
        AND "wallet_accounts"."allow_negative" = false
      ) OR (
        "wallet_accounts"."owner_kind" = 'event'
        AND "wallet_accounts"."user_id" IS NULL
        AND "wallet_accounts"."system_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND "wallet_accounts"."event_id" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "wallet_accounts"."owner_kind" NOT IN ('user', 'event')
        AND "wallet_accounts"."user_id" IS NULL
        AND "wallet_accounts"."system_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND "wallet_accounts"."event_id" IS NULL
      )
